input.narrative: We returned from a long weekend on Monday evening and found the back door forced open, with the frame splintered around the deadbolt. Two laptops, my wife's jewelry box, a camera bag, and the cash we kept in the desk drawer were gone. Drawers were pulled out in every bedroom. We called the police that night and have a report number; the neighbor's doorbell camera shows two people in the yard at around 3 am on Sunday.
